name: authority-host-neutral-provider-declaration
title: Support host-neutral Authority runner provider declarations
description: Allow Lattice CLI Authority runners to declare their host/provider identity without being limited to a small built-in enum, so Codex CLI, Claude Code/Claude CLI, Antigravity, and future agent hosts can register, heartbeat, watch SSE, claim, and handoff/takeover jobs using server policy as the authorization boundary.
